call_input.prompt:
Generate exactly ONE new, independently complete flat poster for a fictional collapsible cup launch. Portrait 4:5 aspect ratio. Output at the maximum resolution currently supported by the tool and model while preserving the requested ratio. The poster itself fills the image: native typography and photographic product imagery together. No mockup, hanging paper, frame, panels, collage of alternatives, or contact sheet.

The poster's organizing fact is a physical HEIGHT DIFFERENCE. Photograph two states of the SAME handleless dark-green silicone cup together on one continuous pale cool-gray studio surface: an expanded cup on the left and the same cup compressed into a low accordion stack on the right. Both rest on the same ground plane, have equal-size matching rims, identical frosted translucent-white lids, matching base diameters, and centered vertical axes. Give the cup plausible compact 350mL product proportions rather than stretching it into a tall vase. Its expanded body is a slightly tapered soft silicone vessel with clear rounded concentric fold joints and a broad circular base; the short state preserves that exact same base as the wall sections nest inward above it. The short state's base must NOT mysteriously grow wider than the expanded base. Its concentric layers remain distinct and plausible, with no melted joints, missing lid, extra phantom rings, or tangled sections. The two states have compatible fold counts, thicknesses, taper and geometry. No handles, hands, straws or accessories.

Photographic realism: slightly elevated frontal three-quarter view that shows matching top ellipses and the lid's real thickness. Dark forest-green matte silicone has fine subtle surface texture and soft broad highlights. White lids are frosted milky translucent, with light diffusing through their rims, not opaque plastic caps. Use one soft upper-left studio key light, consistent gentle rightward shadows and visible local contact shadows under both bases. Keep the material differences, surfaces and edges natural and optically coherent. No logo, letters, embossed marks or printing on either product. No props. The background and floor are one calm seamless photographic space, without decorative texture, horizon line or graphic grid.

Allocate photo scale and ALL copy together from the beginning. The tall left cup's lid and the low right cup's lid define the top and bottom boundaries of a spacious continuous reading area ABOVE THE LOW CUP and directly beside the tall body's visible fold structure. Within this height-difference area, put all seven copy values in ONE coherent optical alignment and spacing system. The entire product identity, name, folding action, specification and buying information must fit in that SAME area and read continuously from top to bottom. Start the fictional identity at the height of the tall cup's lid, then the medium-large name, the folding statement, specification, release date, advance-order period, and shop URL, finishing before the low cup's lid. Align the column with the low cup's central visual mass and optical left edge, with breathing room around the product boundaries. The tall cup's silhouette on the left and the collapsed rim below must visibly define this reading space; the typography uses the height that the shorter state has released. Do not scatter the identity at an unrelated top corner. Do not place any text beneath the product pair, in a separate footer, across the whole bottom of the poster, or on an isolated brand strip. Avoid separate distant text blocks. The release and ordering lines belong to the same continuous reading area as the name and folding copy, and the URL immediately follows the order period.

Make this height-difference area broad enough for the longest required wording at a display width of 720px. Keep the expanded cup slightly narrower or adjust photographic scale before shrinking copy. Use generous, readable, medium-weight Korean and Latin typography with compatible stroke density, common left optical alignment, a small consistent rhythm of spacing, and restrained dark-green contrast. The name is larger than the support copy but does not consume the entire available area; a single-line name is preferred so all remaining copy has proper space. The identity has the same alignment and body-reading rhythm, rather than a remote oversized brand header. The Korean slogan can break naturally at its comma. The specification can break at a semantic boundary if needed. The advance-order copy can break between the wording and date range, keeping the whole range intact. These are natural line breaks, never edits to the wording. Do not turn the lower release/order values into tiny legal text. At width720, all seven values must be plainly legible, especially the longest order wording and complete URL. Keep every text stroke on clean pale negative space without overlap with silicone, lids, shadows or reflections. Do not put boxes, arrows, rules, icons, state captions, numbering, graphic symbols or invented microtext around the words.

The first recognition should be the expanded and compressed same-model pair and its clear height difference; then the eye follows the one continuous identity-to-action copy area bounded by their forms. This is one integrated photographic launch poster, not a still-life with detached top branding and bottom ordering blocks. Do not deform either the cup or glyphs to create a metaphor.

Print ONLY the following seven provided copy values, each exactly once. Exact spelling, case, word spaces, digits and punctuation are required. Preserve the space in 350 mL and use an en dash with no added spaces within the numeric range. Natural word-boundary line breaks are allowed. Do not translate, duplicate, abbreviate or add any copy:
FOLN
Fold Cup
가볍게 접고, 다시 펼치다
350 mL · 접이식 실리콘 컵
2026.12.01 RELEASE
온라인 사전 주문 11.10–11.30
foln.example/store

No real brands, logos, price, certification, invented performance data or watermark. No letters anywhere on the product or background beyond the seven poster values. The provided volume is a copy value, not an invented physical measurement. Deliver exactly one finished portrait 4:5 flat poster image at the maximum supported native resolution.
